mentions.name: Vex
mentions.description: A vehicle expense tracker to keep track of fuel, maintenance, taxes and other car-related costs, giving a more realistic view of the total cost of owning a vehicle. Built with React + Vite on the frontend and Firebase on the backend.
mentions.problem: It is hard to get a realistic view of the total cost of owning a vehicle.
mentions.audience: Individuals tracking the costs of owning their own vehicle.
